description: Eren wears a plain rough olive-brown knee-length tunic with long sleeves and pale linen edging at the collar and cuffs. A dark green-brown checked fringed cloak lies across his shoulders with a simple ring clasp. A plain brown leather belt with a rectangular buckle and long hanging end secures the tunic. Brown trousers, dark lower-leg wraps with crossed ties and brown leather shoes complete the outfit. His short dark hair is uncovered.
